power_factor_unit_check.note: JARVIS n/p-powerfact already in muW/(m K^2) (see 07_duplicate_and_arithmetic_audit.py); ESTM's power_factor(W/mK2) column multiplied by 1e6 to match. After harmonization both medians are the same order of magnitude (JARVIS ~578-870, ESTM ~420), consistent with the conversion direction used.

zt_arithmetic_consistency_check.note: Note: this check uses the same representative 300K-closest row selected for modeling, not every (Formula,T) measurement in the raw file, so n_checked reflects the 880-formula representative set, not all 5205 raw rows.

zt_elec_proxy_wiedemann_franz_check.description: Wiedemann-Franz consistency check: sigma/kappa_elec should equal 1/(L0*T) regardless of any shared relaxation-time normalization, if ncond and nkappa are expressed in mutually consistent units.
zt_elec_proxy_wiedemann_franz_check.conclusion: ncond and nkappa are not in mutually consistent units/normalization (discrepancy ~2.4e14, i.e. ~14 orders of magnitude) -- an electronic-ZT proxy (S^2 sigma T / kappa_elec) computed naively from these two fields is NOT a numerically meaningful ZT value. We therefore do not report an electronic-ZT proxy anywhere in this paper. JARVIS log10(kappa_elec) itself remains a legitimate, internally-consistent ML regression target in its own BoltzTraP-native units, exactly as log10(conductivity) already is throughout Sections 4.1-4.4, since no cross-field ratio is required.
